content: service method VerifyUpdate [SWS_SM_91104] Upstream: RS_SM_00001 , RS_SM_00004 VerifyUpdate (IN FunctionGroupListType functionGroupList) Has to be called by Update And Configuration Management after State Management allowed to update and the update preparation has been done. State Management will decline this request when Prepare Update was not called before successfully.
